def find_in_ascii(frame_ascii, char):
    lines = frame_ascii.split('\n')
    positions = []
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        for j, c in enumerate(line):
            if c == char:
                positions.append((i, j))
    return positions

y_curr = sorted(find_in_ascii(current_frame.ascii, 'Y'))
gameplay_y = [p for p in y_curr if 5 < p[0] < 60]
print(f"Player position: {gameplay_y}")

# Check layout around player and flowers
curr_lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print("Layout (rows 15-32, cols 10-45):")
for i in range(15, 33):
    row = curr_lines[i]
    simplified = ''.join(['.' if c == 'c' else c for c in row[10:46]])
    print(f"Row {i}: '{simplified}'")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
